text: A coiled sword is lodged in Iudex Gundyr's chest, pinning him in place until it is removed.
High Priestess Emma gives the Ashen One the title of Lord Seeker and the Small Lothric Banner, which grants passage to the Undead Settlement.
Pontiff Sulyvahn gave his Outrider Knights cursed rings that gradually transformed them into beasts.
The Transposing Kiln, needed by Ludleth of Courland to reshape boss souls, is found hidden within the remains of the Cursed Greatwood.
Among the remains of the Deacons of the Deep, the Ashen One finds a small doll that serves as the key to unlock the barrier protecting Irithyll.
Defeating the empowered Abyss Watcher yields Cinders of a Lord, one of the four Lord of Cinder souls needed to fill the thrones at Firelink Shrine.
Pontiff Sulyvahn gave Aldrich a doll to ensure his safe passage through Irithyll's barriers to reach Anor Londo.
Among Aldrich's remains lay a cleric's staff, hinting at his origins before becoming a monster.
High Priestess Emma gave the Ashen One the Basin of Vows, an artifact needed to access Lothric Castle.
The Ashen One frees the Painter, who reveals she needs a special pigment, the Dark Soul of Man, from her uncle Gael before she can paint a new world.
Filianore holds an ancient cracked egg in her arms while she sleeps, which serves as the key to the illusions sustaining the Ringed City.

After Gael's death, his blood pools around his fallen body, glowing with the power of the Dark Soul that has shaped humanity since the Furtive Pygmy first claimed it; the Ashen One collects this Dark Soul-infused blood, marking the end of Gael's quest.
Before linking the flame, Yhorm gave his friend Siegward of Catarina the Storm Ruler, a great sword designed to kill giants, with instructions to use it on Yhorm if he ever went mad or hollow.
The battle with the Demon Prince scorched Lorian's greatsword, leaving it permanently wreathed in flame.
